question: Artículos publicados desde el 05/10/2026 a las 00:00 en Lima, incluido el límite; ordenar por id.
sql: SELECT "blog_article"."id", "blog_article"."title", "blog_article"."author_id", "blog_article"."category_id", "blog_article"."published_at", "blog_article"."is_published" FROM "blog_article" WHERE ("blog_article"."is_published" AND "blog_article"."published_at" >= 2026-10-05 05:00:00) ORDER BY "blog_article"."id" ASC

question: Artículos publicados de autores cuyo perfil indica Lima y cuya categoría es Tecnología; ordenar por id.
sql: SELECT "blog_article"."id", "blog_article"."title", "blog_article"."author_id", "blog_article"."category_id", "blog_article"."published_at", "blog_article"."is_published" FROM "blog_article" INNER JOIN "blog_author" ON ("blog_article"."author_id" = "blog_author"."id") INNER JOIN "blog_profile" ON ("blog_author"."id" = "blog_profile"."author_id") INNER JOIN "blog_category" ON ("blog_article"."category_id" = "blog_category"."id") WHERE ("blog_article"."is_published" AND "blog_profile"."city" = Lima AND "blog_category"."name" = Tecnología) ORDER BY "blog_article"."id" ASC

question: Artículos publicados que pertenecen a Tecnología o no tienen categoría; ordenar por id.

question: Autores con al menos un artículo publicado etiquetado django, sin repetir autores; ordenar por id.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT "blog_author"."id", "blog_author"."name", "blog_author"."email" FROM "blog_author" INNER JOIN "blog_article" ON ("blog_author"."id" = "blog_article"."author_id") INNER JOIN "blog_article_tags" ON ("blog_article"."id" = "blog_article_tags"."article_id") INNER JOIN "blog_tag" ON ("blog_article_tags"."tag_id" = "blog_tag"."id") WHERE ("blog_article"."is_published" AND "blog_tag"."name" = django) ORDER BY "blog_author"."id" ASC

question: Todos los artículos con n_comments y n_tags, incluidos comentarios no aprobados; ordenar por id.

question: Autores que no tienen ningún comentario aprobado en ninguno de sus artículos, incluidos autores sin artículos; ordenar por id.
sql: SELECT "blog_author"."id", "blog_author"."name", "blog_author"."email" FROM "blog_author" WHERE NOT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 AS "a" FROM "blog_article" U1 INNER JOIN "blog_comment" U2 ON (U1."id" = U2."article_id") WHERE (U2."is_approved" AND U1."author_id" = ("blog_author"."id")) LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY "blog_author"."id" ASC

question: Categorías con al menos dos artículos publicados y su n_articles publicado; ordenar por id.
sql: SELECT "blog_category"."id", "blog_category"."name", COUNT("blog_article"."id") FILTER (WHERE "blog_article"."is_published") AS "n_articles" FROM "blog_category" LEFT OUTER JOIN "blog_article" ON ("blog_category"."id" = "blog_article"."category_id") GROUP BY "blog_category"."id", "blog_category"."name" HAVING COUNT("blog_article"."id") FILTER (WHERE ("blog_article"."is_published")) >= 2 ORDER BY "blog_category"."id" ASC
